ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב הִמְשִׁיךְ בְּדַרְכּוֹ וְהִרְגִּישׁ שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ הֲגָנָה.
ideas.children_en: Jacob said goodbye to Laban peacefully and continued his journey. On the way, he met many angels and called the place 'Machanayim' for the camps of angels and his own camp.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב שָׁלַח לְעֵשָׂו מִלִּים מְכֻבָּדוֹת כְּדֵי לַעֲשׂוֹת שָׁלוֹם.
ideas.children_en: Jacob sent messengers to Esau with a respectful message. He told that he stayed with Laban and has much property. He wanted peace with Esau.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב פָּחַד מִפְּגִישָׁה עִם אָחִיו וְדָאַג לְמִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Jacob heard Esau was coming with many men. He was afraid Esau might hurt him and his family. So he prayed to God and asked for help and protection.
Jacob sent Esau big gifts. He put the gifts far apart to impress Esau. He hoped this would make Esau accept him kindly.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב דָּאַג לְהַעֲבִיר אֶת מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ בְּבִטְחָה.
ideas.children_en: Jacob moved his family and belongings over the Yabbok river at night in many trips because he could not move everything at once.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב נֶאֱבַק כָּל הַלַּיְלָה וְקִבֵּל שֵׁם חָדָשׁ, יִשְׂרָאֵל.
ideas.children_en: Jacob stayed alone and wrestled a mysterious man all night. After his leg was hurt, Jacob asked for a blessing and got a new name, Israel, because he fought and won.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב נָתַן שֵׁם לַמָּקוֹם כְּדֵי לִזְכֹּר אֶת הַפְּגִישָׁה הַמְּיֻחֶדֶת.
ideas.children_en: Jacob named the place Peniel because he saw an angel face to face there, but he stayed alive, unlike what others feared.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב הִמְשִׁיךְ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁנִּפְצַע.
ideas.children_en: When the sun rose the angel left, and Jacob crossed Peniel limping because of his hurt leg.

ideas.children_he: מִנְהָגִים מְסֻיָּמִים מַזְכִּירִים לָנוּ סִפּוּר מִן הֶעָבָר.
ideas.children_en: The Israelites do not eat the sinew on the thigh because of Jacob's injury. This rule applies to animals too.
